{{recipe}}

Sweet and spicy. It's a nice twist on a barbecue favorite.

== Ingredients ==
*4 [[Cookbook:Each|each]] boneless skinless [[Cookbook:Chicken#Breast|chicken breasts]] and [[Cookbook:Chicken#Leg|chicken drumsticks]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Barbecue Chicken Rub|Barbecue Chicken Rub]]
*1 cup [[Cookbook:Cola BBQ Sauce|Cola BBQ Sauce]]

==Procedure==
#Season chicken with Rub.
#Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
#Preheat [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] for medium heat.
#Place chicken on grill and turn often, [[Cookbook:Basting|basting]] with sauce every time the chicken is turned until internal temperature reaches 165°F inside the breast and 170°F in the drumstick.
#Rest 15 minutes; serve.
